svg.text: One solution per dimension D, each with its own wave
D is not a time or a place: it is the number of spacetime dimensions, a setting of the problem. For each D there is a separate critical solution.
Each repeats in its own echo period Δ, and over one period its centre field p1 is a wave. Higher D gives a smaller wave, a shorter period and a smaller harmonic 5.
each box: p1 over one echo period of that solution, all on one vertical scale
Harmonic 5 against D: each solution above gives one point
